screens.title: Make room for what you could become.
screens.subtitle: Bring what you are learning. Understand it, try it and build work you can show.

screens.title: A clearer way through your learning.
screens.subtitle: Your material, an interactive teacher and a place to put the idea to work.

screens.title: Start with one small idea.
screens.subtitle: Take a short lesson with Rain. No microphone or account needed.

screens.title: Welcome back.
screens.subtitle: Continue where you left off.

screens.title: Your next step starts here.
screens.subtitle: Create your learning space. You can explore a sample first.

screens.title: Check your email.
screens.subtitle: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email address.

screens.title: Let’s get you back in.
screens.subtitle: Enter your email address. If an account exists, we will send a recovery link.

screens.title: Choose a new password.
screens.subtitle: Use a password you do not use on another service.

screens.title: What brings you here?
screens.subtitle: Choose a starting point. You can change direction later.

screens.title: What are you learning?
screens.subtitle: Add your institution and programme, or start with a topic.

screens.title: Choose the subjects that fit.
screens.subtitle: Check the course year and source before adding a suggested module.

screens.title: Choose your language.
screens.subtitle: Interface, teaching text and voice can be chosen separately.

screens.title: Make learning comfortable.
screens.subtitle: Captions, readable text and keyboard controls stay available.

screens.title: A little about you.
screens.subtitle: Your name helps us welcome you. A photo, CV and bio are optional.

screens.title: Meet Rain.
screens.subtitle: Choose how you would like to learn together. You can start with text only.

screens.title: Your space is ready.
screens.subtitle: Start with a sample or bring something you want to understand.

screens.title: What would you like to understand today?
screens.subtitle: Continue a lesson, bring your material or try a practical challenge.

screens.title: Start with something real.
screens.subtitle: A difficult passage, a question you missed or a skill you want to use.

screens.title: Find your next step.
screens.subtitle: Search your material, lessons, saved work and reviewed resources.

screens.title: My material
screens.subtitle: Your sources and lessons, kept together.

screens.title: Find a useful starting point.
screens.subtitle: Browse reviewed resources. Check the source and coverage before using them.

screens.title: Bring your material.
screens.subtitle: Add a document, scan a page, paste text or use a supported reference.

screens.title: Opening your material.
screens.subtitle: We will keep the source beside the extracted text so you can check it.

screens.title: Check the text before we teach it.
screens.subtitle: Correct anything the scan missed. Your original file stays unchanged.

screens.title: Your source is ready.
screens.subtitle: Select a passage to read, explain or translate, or build a lesson around it.

screens.title: What would you like to do with this passage?
screens.subtitle: Your selection stays linked to its page and saved source revision.

screens.title: Read it in another language.
screens.subtitle: Keep the original beside the translation and check technical terms.

screens.title: A plan for this idea.
screens.subtitle: Check the goal, source coverage and activities before starting.

screens.title: Preparing your lesson.
screens.subtitle: You can keep reading the reviewed source while the lesson is prepared.

screens.title: Your lesson is ready.
screens.subtitle: Read the goal, choose a view and start when you are ready.

screens.title: Choose a place to explore.
screens.subtitle: Start with an available studio or use reading view for any supported lesson.

screens.title: Follow the stock, not the guess.
screens.subtitle: Stock control · Opening stock and a delivery

screens.title: The same lesson, a quieter view.
screens.subtitle: Read the explanation, check the source and try a step at your own pace.

screens.title: Check where the idea comes from.
screens.subtitle: The highlighted passage supports this step. A citation is not an official marking memo.

screens.title: Let’s take a smaller step.
screens.subtitle: Your lesson is paused. Your place and notes are kept.

screens.title: What would you like to ask?
screens.subtitle: Choose a number, line or object, or type your question below.

screens.title: Let’s connect it to your source.
screens.subtitle: A short explanation, with the relevant passage close by.

screens.title: Choose whether to use your microphone.
screens.subtitle: Voice questions are optional. You can always type instead.

screens.title: I’m listening.
screens.subtitle: Finish your thought, then choose Send. Stop listening whenever you need.

screens.title: Did we get that right?
screens.subtitle: Check names, numbers and technical terms before sending.

screens.title: Another way to see the idea.
screens.subtitle: Check the source and choose whether to open this video.

screens.title: Watch what changes.
screens.subtitle: Change one value, then explain why the result changes.

screens.title: Your turn.
screens.subtitle: Use the stock record to work out the expected closing quantity.

screens.title: Check the working.
screens.subtitle: Compare your answer with the record, then try a changed example.

screens.title: Keep what clicked.
screens.subtitle: Review the idea, the help you used and what to try next.

screens.title: My lesson notes
screens.subtitle: Add your explanation or a question for next time.

screens.title: Take a copy with you.
screens.subtitle: Your notes include source references and your practice record.

screens.title: Choose what to save.
screens.subtitle: Saved reading can work without a connection. New answers and media may still need data.

screens.title: Saved for later
screens.subtitle: Reading copies and notes on this device. Check the saved date before relying on them.

screens.title: Keep learning with what is saved.
screens.subtitle: This copy is available on this device. New questions will wait for a connection.

screens.title: Inside an electric motor.
screens.subtitle: Select a part, look inside and see how its job connects to the whole.

screens.title: See how the parts fit.
screens.subtitle: The stator stays still. The rotor turns inside it.

screens.title: Change one condition.
screens.subtitle: Observe the illustrative operating field, then predict what happens next.

screens.title: Connect the model to the maths.
screens.subtitle: Calculate synchronous speed from frequency and the number of poles.

screens.title: What happens after a click?
screens.subtitle: Follow a request from the browser to a query, then back to your screen.

screens.title: Follow the request.
screens.subtitle: Inspect the route, the parameter and the rows returned.

screens.title: This studio is still being prepared.
screens.subtitle: You can learn from reviewed reading and diagrams while a specialist environment is developed.

screens.title: Practise something useful.
screens.subtitle: Choose a case, make a decision and keep the work that shows your reasoning.

screens.title: The shelf count is short.
screens.subtitle: Reconcile the records before deciding what to tell the next shift.

screens.title: Make the evidence clear.
screens.subtitle: Review your working and which claims the records actually support.

screens.title: Work you can explain.
screens.subtitle: Keep projects, practice and feedback with the conditions under which you completed them.

screens.title: Stock reconciliation
screens.subtitle: A practice record with your reasoning, feedback and source.

screens.title: Your work, in one place.
screens.subtitle: Choose the work you want to show. Practice is not employment or an accredited credential.

screens.title: Choose what someone can see.
screens.subtitle: Review each item before creating a share or export. Private notes are excluded unless you add them.

screens.title: Review your sharing choices.
screens.subtitle: No public link is created until a supported sharing service is enabled and you confirm.

screens.title: See what is becoming clearer.
screens.subtitle: Look at your attempts and independent practice, then choose a useful next step.

screens.title: Find a direction that fits.
screens.subtitle: Start with your interests and work you can show. You do not need a job title yet.

screens.title: Start with what you enjoy doing.
screens.subtitle: Choose tasks you are curious about. These are suggestions, not a test of your potential.

screens.title: What does this role ask for?
screens.subtitle: Compare a dated role brief with your confirmed skills and work.

screens.title: Check the role evidence.
screens.subtitle: Requirements can change. Verify the current posting before applying.

screens.title: Build towards the role.
screens.subtitle: Turn each gap into a lesson, a practical task and work you can review.

screens.title: Build work worth discussing.
screens.subtitle: Practise with public or synthetic data and explain your decisions.

screens.title: Make a service queue easier to understand.
screens.subtitle: Inspect a synthetic dataset, find quality issues and explain the effect on a report.

screens.title: Bring your experience into view.
screens.subtitle: A CV can help fill your profile. Check every extracted detail before using it.

screens.title: Put your experience into your own words.
screens.subtitle: Only include details you can confirm. Projects and practice stay distinct from employment.

screens.title: Check before you share.
screens.subtitle: Use clear headings and truthful evidence. Follow the employer’s requested file format.

screens.title: Find somewhere to use your skills.
screens.subtitle: Explore jobs, WIL, volunteering, hackathons and bursaries. Check dates and eligibility.

screens.title: Check the opportunity before you act.
screens.subtitle: Read the original source, deadline, eligibility and information requested.

screens.title: Review what would be shared.
screens.subtitle: Confirm the destination, document and personal details before any external action.

screens.title: Your application draft
screens.subtitle: Prepared does not mean submitted. A confirmed submission needs a receipt from the destination.

screens.title: Tools for this task.
screens.subtitle: Read data, create a document or inspect a result in a controlled workspace.

screens.title: Allow only what this task needs.
screens.subtitle: Check the action, destination, files and expiry. You can decline.

screens.title: Review the result.
screens.subtitle: Check what changed and the receipt before keeping the output.

screens.title: Your updates
screens.subtitle: Keep useful reminders. Choose which ones you want to receive.

screens.title: Your profile
screens.subtitle: Review your goals, course details and the work you choose to show.

screens.title: Make KAIRO work for you.
screens.subtitle: Choose your teacher, language, access preferences and what is remembered.

screens.title: Your teacher
screens.subtitle: Voice, appearance and language are separate choices.

screens.title: Language
screens.subtitle: Choose the interface, lesson text and voice separately. Availability may differ.

screens.title: Accessibility
screens.subtitle: Adjust the experience without changing the learning goal.

screens.title: Appearance
screens.subtitle: Keep the tone you like, with readable contrast and a comfortable text size.

screens.title: Downloads and data
screens.subtitle: Choose what to keep on this device and when larger files may download.

screens.title: What KAIRO remembers
screens.subtitle: Review goals, preferences and saved summaries. You can correct or remove them.

screens.title: Privacy and permissions
screens.subtitle: Choose what may leave your device and review the services involved.

screens.title: Connected services
screens.subtitle: Review each service before connecting it. A connection does not allow every action.

screens.title: Review the connection.
screens.subtitle: Check the service, data scope and how to disconnect before you continue.

screens.title: Notifications
screens.subtitle: Choose reminders that help. Quiet hours and turning them off are always available.

screens.title: Account and security
screens.subtitle: Review sign-in methods, recovery and devices with access to your account.

screens.title: Take a copy of your data.
screens.subtitle: Choose the records to include. Exports may contain personal information.

screens.title: Your export choices
screens.subtitle: Review the scope and file type before downloading to this device.

screens.title: Delete only what you choose.
screens.subtitle: Removing a download, clearing this device and deleting an account are different actions.

screens.title: Check what would be removed.
screens.subtitle: This action should never silently remove other learning records.

screens.title: Find your way through.
screens.subtitle: Get help with material, lessons, access, voice or saved work.

screens.title: Tell us what got in the way.
screens.subtitle: Share only what you choose. Do not include passwords or private source text.

screens.title: Ready to leave this device?
screens.subtitle: Choose whether saved downloads should remain here. Keep a copy of unsaved work first.

screens.title: Signed-language support
screens.subtitle: Choose reviewed SASL material when it is available for this lesson. Captions and readable text remain separate options.

screens.title: This file could not be read.
screens.subtitle: Try a clearer image, an unencrypted document or pasted text. Your earlier material is still here.

screens.title: The teacher cannot answer right now.
screens.subtitle: Keep reading your saved source or try again. Your place and notes are kept.

screens.title: Sign in to continue.
screens.subtitle: Keep your local draft, then sign in before sending or syncing changes.

screens.title: Two versions need a choice.
screens.subtitle: Review this device’s draft and the saved version before replacing anything.

screens.title: This device could not save your changes.
screens.subtitle: Download a copy before leaving. Earlier saved work has not been replaced.

screens.title: Microphone access is off.
screens.subtitle: You can type your question or change this site’s permission in your browser.

screens.title: Keep your changes before you leave.
screens.subtitle: Save, download a copy or leave this draft unchanged.
